title: BestShockers (Zac) Doxing me

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Athune,

As the head TS Dev, I am in charge of Zac and what he does while he is a TS Dev. 

As of now, there is no policy against any staff member doing this action, and even if there was, he did this over Skype, which is not an Avicus platform. We cannot control the fact that you added him as a contact on Skype. Also, it seems that there was only one person who put your personal information out publicly on TS, and that was yourself. 

Anyways, this report is denied.
